limitations: Cached facts currently provide no aliases; no aliases or QIDs are invented.
John Green is absent from this fact cache, so both current John Green records return no match. Virginia Woolf Q40909 is covered by a positive fixture.
Surname-only names, mononyms, declensions, transliterations and fuzzy name guesses are held.
An exact identity mention does not prove authorship, suitable portrait context or media licensing; the downstream resolver must make those separate checks.
Headline identities take precedence; two returned identities mean multi-person ambiguity, never permission to choose arbitrarily.
Summary-only names require a literal surname anchor in the headline; known award/institution eponyms are held. This avoids choosing former winners or incidental influences as portraits.

freshSearchHints.scope: Unapproved offline search queries only; actual network identity verification belongs to the downstream resolver.
